summary: Live page says closed for the season; the 2026-05-19 Wayback capture gives the 2026 terms: $50 flat (water + 50 A), 2-night minimum, phone reservations 24 h ahead, showers/bathrooms closed, back-in only. Season changed year-round -> seasonal (May to ~mid-Oct, no dates). Fees, hookups, sites, facilities, season, booking written; note rewritten.
flags: CRITERIA (fairgrounds, reviewer decides): the operator calls it 'a limited-service event campground', but the 2026 page sells ordinary nights to anyone by phone ('Nightly Camping - $50', 24-hour advance reservations, office hours Mon-Fri) with no event-participant restriction - read as renting ordinary nights outside events. No dated camper review was read to confirm a non-event stay.
MINIMUM STAY: '2-night minimum stay required' all season - under the 3-night drop threshold; written to booking.min_stay.

SEASON: stored year_round true (derived from the sweep note 'available year-round') is contradicted - live page 'closed for the season' (Nov 2026), Oct 2025 and Jan-Feb 2026 captures closed, 'We will start taking reservations for 2026 in May'.

FACILITIES: 'Showers / Bathrooms - CLOSED' in the 2025 and 2026 captures - stored showers true (derived) -> false. Stored note's 'remodeled restrooms/showers' and '$30 (30A) / $50 (50A)' are superseded.
SITES: stored count 70 has no source on the operator page (left unchanged); pull_through cleared - page says 'Our Sites are back in only' while its map legend calls Area A 'gravel pull through's'.
UNREAD: the live 2026-11 page shows only the closed notice; terms come from the 2026-05-19 Wayback capture (route: plain curl of web.archive.org). The CampgroundSites.pdf map was not opened.
PHONE 605-355-3861 and WEBSITE keep. PIN fine (beside the East Campground rows). WATERFRONT: not waterfront. Ownership local (fair association on the county fairgrounds) stays.
